title: Sprint 5 — Async JavaScript & APIs
description: Unlock the power of asynchronous programming to fetch live data and create applications that feel fast and responsive.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Asynchronous Foundations
tickets.description: Master the flow of time in your applications. You will learn to handle delayed actions and manage complex sequences of events smoothly.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.1 — setTimeout, setInterval & Event Loop
tasks.description: Implement precise timing controls to manage ongoing background tasks in your application.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.2 — Promises: Creating & Chaining
tasks.description: Coordinate multi-step processes efficiently, ensuring your application handles potential issues gracefully.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.3 — async/await & Error Handling
tasks.description: Write cleaner, more readable asynchronous code to manage complex sequences of operations.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Working with APIs
tickets.description: Connect your applications to the real world. You will retrieve remote data, optimize performance, and ensure a resilient user experience.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.1 — fetch() & Rendering API Data
tasks.description: Integrate live data from external services directly into your web pages.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.2 — Search with Debounce
tasks.description: Optimize user search experiences to be responsive without overwhelming external servers.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)

tasks.title: Task 5.2.3 — Loading / Error / Empty States
tasks.description: Provide clear feedback to users during data loading, ensuring they always know what is happening.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)

tasks.title: Task 5.2.4 — localStorage Persistence
tasks.description: Remember user preferences so they enjoy a customized experience every time they return.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)
